items.title: Can Mastercard (MA) Justify A Premium Through Excess Returns?
items.summary: Mastercard has delivered strong multi year returns for shareholders. At a last close of US$661.71, the key issue for anyone looking at the stock today is whether that price is still supported by the returns the business earns on its capital. Over the past 5 years, Mastercard has returned 112.2%, which puts real weight on the question of whether its current valuation lines up with the quality and durability of those capital returns.
